description.zh: 按应用技能管理群晖笔记、日历、文件、下载、套件、容器、虚拟机、照片与音乐，支持 DSM 系统巡检；先核对能力，变更预览后执行并验证。
description.en: Use app-specific skills for Synology notes, calendar, files, downloads, packages, containers, VMs, photos and music, plus DSM health checks. Verify capabilities, preview changes and check results.

welcome_message.zh: 我是你的群晖管家。想查看笔记、安排日历、管理应用，或检查 NAS 状态和整理文件，直接告诉我，我会按应用选择技能并核对实际能力。
welcome_message.en: I am your Synology NAS manager. Ask about notes, calendar, apps, NAS health or files. I will select the relevant app skill and verify its capabilities.

description.zh: 查看笔记本，选择范围后查找或摘要
description.en: Choose a notebook before finding or summarizing notes

prompt.zh: 帮我查看群晖 Note Station 中可访问的笔记本，先列出笔记本，让我选择要查找或整理的范围，不修改笔记。
prompt.en: List my accessible Note Station notebooks so I can choose where to search or organize notes. Do not change any notes.

description.zh: 按服务端时区查看今天的日程
description.en: Check today's schedule using the server timezone

prompt.zh: 查看群晖 Synology Calendar 中今天的日程。先确认服务端时区、可访问的日历和接口能力，只查询，不创建或修改事件。
prompt.en: Show today's events in Synology Calendar. First verify the server timezone, accessible calendars and API capabilities. Do not create or modify events.

description.zh: 检查负载、容量与硬盘健康，只读巡检
description.en: Inspect load, capacity and disk health without changes

prompt.zh: 帮我对已连接的群晖 NAS 做一次只读健康巡检，先确认账号和连接，再检查系统负载、存储空间、硬盘健康和相关告警。不要启动检测任务或修改设置。
prompt.en: Run a read-only health check on my connected Synology NAS. Confirm the connection and account, then inspect load, storage capacity, disk health and relevant alerts. Do not start tests or change settings.

description.zh: 先列出目录，预览整理方案再操作
description.en: List files and preview a plan before changes

prompt.zh: 帮我整理群晖中的文件。先查看我可访问的共享目录，询问要整理的目录，再给出具体方案；不要直接删除或覆盖。
prompt.en: Help organize files on my Synology NAS. List accessible shares, ask which folder to organize, and preview a concrete plan before making changes. Do not delete or overwrite files.

description.zh: 查看下载状态，按要求添加或暂停任务
description.en: Inspect downloads and add or pause tasks on request

prompt.zh: 查看群晖 Download Station 的当前任务和状态，告诉我哪些正在下载、已完成或出错；先不要修改任务。
prompt.en: List current Synology Download Station tasks and identify downloading, completed and failed tasks. Do not change any tasks yet.

description.zh: 查看安装版本和运行状态，诊断异常
description.en: Check installed versions and service health

prompt.zh: 检查群晖已安装套件的运行状态和版本，重点列出异常或停止的服务；只查询，不自动安装、升级或重启。
prompt.en: Inspect installed Synology packages, versions and running states. Highlight failed or stopped services without installing, upgrading or restarting anything.

zh: 每天「09:00」只读检查群晖系统负载和存储容量，仅在异常时通知我
每周一「10:00」汇总群晖硬盘健康与存储池状态，只读查询，不启动检测任务
每天「18:00」汇总 Download Station 的失败任务，只汇报，不自动重试或删除
每周五「16:00」检查已安装套件状态，列出停止或异常的服务，不自动启停
每「4 小时」只读检查存储空间，使用率超过 85% 时通知我，不删除数据
每月 1 日「10:00」生成 NAS 容量和健康摘要，不修改任何设置
en: Every day at 09:00, check NAS load and capacity read-only and notify me only about problems
Every Monday at 10:00, summarize disk health and storage pools without starting disk tests
Every day at 18:00, report failed Download Station tasks without retrying or deleting them
Every Friday at 16:00, report stopped or abnormal packages without changing their state
Every 4 hours, check storage read-only and notify me above 85% usage without deleting data
On the first day of each month at 10:00, report NAS capacity and health without changes
